name: Eleni Papadopoulos
bio:
Eleni's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a successful career in human resources within the tech industry, she attended a Formula 1 race in Monza and was immediately captivated by the blend of technical prowess and human drama. Recognizing the need for structured HR practices within the often chaotic world of racing, she transitioned her career, initially taking on consulting roles for smaller teams before moving to a full-time position. 

Eleni is a firm believer in fostering a positive and productive work environment through fair and consistent policies. She focuses on talent acquisition, employee development, and conflict resolution. Her pragmatic approach allows her to make tough decisions while remaining empathetic to the needs of individual team members. What sets her apart is her ability to see the bigger picture, understanding how each role contributes to the overall success of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a low ponytail
physical.description: Eleni is a woman of average height with a warm smile and intelligent eyes.

quirks: Insists on using a fountain pen for all official documents.
Always has a small bowl of Greek olives on her desk.
Starts every Monday morning with a team-building puzzle.
